'''Chikatsu Shrine''' (近津神社) refers to multiple {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} across Japan. There are 23 shrines officially named Chikatsu Shrine and 3 shrines with "Chikatsu" included in their names.

== '''Chikatsu Shrines''' ([[:ja:近津神社|近津神社]]) ==
Many of these shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Chikatō-no-Kami|ja|千鹿頭神|1=Chikatō-no-Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikatō-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikatō-no-Kami|qq=}}
